verdict.rationale: Okta exposes Admin Management APIs, which its official MCP server wraps for operations like creating users, adding them to groups, querying failed logins, and listing unused apps. It also offers SCIM CRUD on users and groups, outbound event hooks, and a free plan for managing and automating Okta. Nothing in the evidence states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at standard paths. missing for 10: explicit documented API/UI parity claim, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, coverage evidence for admin areas beyond users/groups/apps/logs, independent hands-on corroboration of parity
